title: Arm both close-door predicates on the unrecorded marker
action: Teach both feature-debt predicates to arm on the new marker from wc-1. featureVerifyDebt (state.mjs:2502-2518) currently arms only when a capped cell carries trace.feature_verify === "pending"; it must arm equally on trace.proof === "unrecorded" (per D11/D12). testCellDebt (state.mjs:2546-2570) currently treats only trace.verify_passed === false as not-green; a capped test cell whose pass was asserted with no recorded output must not satisfy the door either (per D11). Critical: the freshness comparison — newestPendingCapMs around state.mjs:2506-2523 — must compute over the UNION of pending and unrecorded caps, so a green feature-verify record newer than the newest pending cap but older than a newer unrecorded cap still refuses the close-door (per D12). Do not add a new debt kind unless the coverage-completeness meta-check at test_bee_cli.mjs:2670 demands one; prefer widening the existing 'feature-verify' and 'test-cell' kinds so every registered door inherits the change for free via guardFeatureDebt. High-risk lane, so red-first: write the failing tests first in packages/bee/tests/test_bee_cli.mjs, extending the DEBT_KIND_FIXTURES at :2617-2621 and the generated door x kind matrix at :2699-2719. The existing bypass-total case at :2575 must stay green — gate_bypass total still cannot pass either door.

truths: A capped cell carrying trace.proof === "unrecorded" arms featureVerifyDebt exactly as a pending cap does
A green feature-verify record older than the newest unrecorded cap does not clear the door
A capped test cell whose pass was asserted with no output does not satisfy testCellDebt
gate_bypass total still cannot pass either door
Every registered door in the door x kind matrix inherits the new behavior

artifacts.substantive: featureVerifyDebt and testCellDebt arm on the unrecorded marker; newestPendingCapMs computes over the union
fixtures and matrix rows covering the unrecorded marker at every door, plus the union-staleness case

key_links: guardFeatureDebt composes both widened predicates so no door builds its own list
prohibitions: No door may call featureVerifyDebt or testCellDebt directly — the structural check at test_bee_cli.mjs:2682 must stay green
No bypass level may be given power over either door
No change to the feature-verify recording contract itself

trace.outcome: featureVerifyDebt and testCellDebt arm on trace.proof "unrecorded" as well as feature_verify "pending"; freshness clock runs over the union of both; an asserted-pass test cell no longer satisfies the test-cell door
